name: REINCAR
source:
This story is about Eliot, a human from our world and his story after he mysteriously wakes up in a foreign world where his only lifeline is a werewolf-like person that is willing to help Eliot find a way to the nearest safe place, however the road there is a long one and their vastly different lives will make living and understanding each other a difficult challenge to face while traveling.

[From [url=https://wyyth.itch.io/reincarvn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕来自我们这个世界的人类Eliot展开。他神秘地在异世界醒来，唯一的依靠，是一位愿意帮他前往最近安全之地的狼人般的人物。然而，前路漫长，两人截然不同的人生经历，也让旅途中的相处与相互理解，成了一项艰难的挑战。

[摘自[url=https://wyyth.itch.io/reincarvn]itch.io[/url]]
